AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE
23A-160
STEP 41. Check the Park/Neutral position switch.
Check for continuity between terminals for each selector 
position.
NOTE: For vehicles with sport mode, four positions (P, R, N, D) 
are used.
Q: Is the switch operating properly?
YES : Go to Step 42.
NO : Replace the Park/Neutral position switch. Refer to 
GROUP 23B, Transaxle P.23B-11.
STEP 42. Check connector B-41 at the Park/Neutral 
position switch for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 43.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
